TASTE — The chapter sits only 59 words above the lower density bound (3,969 against 3,910). It nevertheless dramatizes every promised turn rather than summarizing it, so the number is not itself a defect; any repair should stay local rather than padding the scene.

SET-PIECE ANSWER — There is no fight by design. The blanket reconciliation is a memorable procedural set piece: its physical terrain—rows, columns, weights, two pages and an undrawn gutter—is load-bearing. Its non-combat win can be written as: Karis removed Vastin's ability to turn two observations into an order by invoking the ruler rule and physically separating the findings.
strengths: WORLDBUILDING ANSWER — Yes. Worldbuilding is consistently done through mechanism and use: the office exists as columns, ruling hands, seals, provenance and suppression procedure; the taxonomy exists as marks, distances, dividers and corroborated dates; the Path mystery exists as repeated measured failure rather than a lore lecture.

The chapter pays a long evidentiary arc without spending the Book 9 reveal. Karis finally says the lamps finding, Vastin starts the forbidden join, and the two-page refusal turns epistemic discipline into action rather than cautionary exposition.

Cael's choice not to add his private date is the chapter's human progression. He applies Karis's standard at the moment it would be easiest to use secret knowledge as certainty, showing restraint behaviorally and preserving the knowledge boundary.

The Compact fracture arrives through paper mechanics rather than a villain speech: two hands, two equally authoritative seals, an order on one face and an objection on the other. Vastin's refusal to name or exploit the factions keeps the pre-echo at the correct altitude.

The injury inventory is economical and relational. Two sticks, Teague's idle hand, Karis's bound hand, Brom's hidden bruises, Oryn's grey depletion, and the older healer binding at Oryn's leave carry costs forward while advancing trust.

The fixed close earns its desire statement. The map is physically reconciled before Cael says what he wants, Karis asks 'Why' in her measurement register, and the final narrator line changes pressure without explaining the coming payoff.
The chapter fully preserves the reader standard: careful truth-telling, restraint and care carry the drama; there is no profanity, cruelty, gore, sexual content or cynical modern register.
